headline: Why PACCAR (PCAR) Is Up 5.4% After Q2 Margin Gains And Record Parts Revenue - And What's Next
summary: PACCAR Inc recently reported its second-quarter 2026 results, with sales of US$6,997 million and net income of US$752 million, alongside basic earnings per share from continuing operations of US$1.43.
